name: Reclaimed Treasures
summary: Krom Stoutarm asks you to recover a treasured possession from Uldaman. He waits for it in Ironforge.

sections.title: A Lost Possession
sections.body: Krom Stoutarm has a chest in Uldaman's North Common Hall. You are asked to bring his treasured possession from it to him in Ironforge.

faq.answer: Krom Stoutarm asks you to recover his treasured possession from a chest in Uldaman.
Krom Stoutarm's chest is in the North Common Hall of Uldaman.
Krom wants his treasured possession from the chest in Uldaman.
Bring Krom Stoutarm's treasured possession to him in Ironforge.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you are helping Krom Stoutarm recover a treasured possession and return it to him in Ironforge.
As an Alliance member, you are asked to bring Krom Stoutarm's treasured possession from Uldaman to him in Ironforge.
